note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined, or the shortest span carrying the quoted clause (pieces joined with … where Bounds drops words). `self_rendered` rows are quotations Bounds recasts to fit his sentence (re-personed or dramatized), places he argues from a KJV word OWB does not use (Isa 45:11 'command ye me', John 11:38 'groaning', Rom 8:26 'as we ought', Mark 13:33 'and pray'), and allusions or paraphrases in his own voice, left as the translator's prose.
